scope: Determine whether locally available open-source consumers can independently qualify native dynamic-block evaluation for the AC1024 two-root profile.

installedCandidates.qualification: Useful for the separate FreeCAD DWG-to-DXF open/import workflow and static geometry inspection, but not admitted as an oracle for dynamic-block parameter/action evaluation.
Format converter; no dynamic-block editing or evaluator observed. It cannot independently establish evaluated visibility/action meaning.
Independent DWG parser/field observation only; no dynamic-block evaluator qualification.

localEnvironment.execution: No FreeCAD document was opened and no dynamic action was evaluated in this research pass. Bundle/version inventory and official source/documentation inspection only.

officialEvidence.finding: FreeCAD documents its C++ DXF importer as importing block geometry while skipping text, dimensions and attributes inside blocks; its listed import objects contain no dynamic-block evaluation path. The legacy importer list likewise does not describe dynamic-block evaluation.
officialEvidence.use: FreeCAD import is not an independent semantic oracle for parameter/action-driven dynamic-block behavior.

officialEvidence.finding: The current official importDXF module contains no AcDbEvalExpr, BLOCKVISIBILITYPARAMETER or dynamic-block evaluator implementation in the searched source.
officialEvidence.use: Source inspection corroborates the documented importer scope; absence alone is not treated as universal proof about every FreeCAD extension.

officialEvidence.finding: FreeCAD imports DWG through an external converter to DXF and then uses its standard DXF importer.
officialEvidence.use: FreeCAD remains relevant to the separate end-to-end dwg2dxf/open workflow, but the converter-plus-import route does not supply a dynamic-block evaluator.

officialEvidence.finding: Autodesk describes AcDbEvalGraph as the network implementing dynamic-block behavior and evaluates dependent expressions in graph order.
officialEvidence.use: The remaining semantic gate must exercise an evaluator and observe behavior, not only compare transported node/edge fields.

officialEvidence.finding: Autodesk's Dynamic Block API Overview describes dynamic block instances as independently adjustable and the graph classes as defining, storing and evaluating relationships between authoring elements.
officialEvidence.use: The consumer witness should change a parameter/action and verify the resulting instance geometry/visibility.

parentIdBoundary.sourceObservation: The fresh ASCII/Binary DXF readback receipt records source EvalExpr.parentId 0xFFFFFFFF becoming model default 0 for BLOCKLINEARGRIP handle 0x1111 because the current DXF projection omits that field.
parentIdBoundary.documentationSearch: The searched public Autodesk DXF pages did not provide a group-code mapping for this custom AcDbEvalExpr parentId field.
parentIdBoundary.disposition: UNRESOLVED. Do not call the normalization semantics-neutral. Resolve with authoritative field/profile evidence or a native evaluator roundtrip.

remaining: Use an independently implemented dynamic-block evaluator, with exact product/version and operation bound to the exact source/output bytes, to test both roots, visibility, parameter/action behavior and reachable geometry.
Resolve the parentId projection boundary before promoting dynamic-block semantics.
Continue locally actionable DXF-origin typed/raw adapter replay work without waiting for a native consumer.
limitations: FreeCAD's documentation describes supported importer scope but does not prove behavior of every future importer, extension or application version.
